verdict.rationale: Trello documents a visual board for tracking task progress and offers templates. Community users describe running software feature-implementation workflows on it (Idea => Doing => Done) and call it a step up from Pivotal Tracker, so basic agile task flow is supported. Nothing in the pack documents sprint-specific features. missing for 10: sprint/iteration planning and time-boxing, backlog management, story points or estimation, velocity/burndown reporting, first-party agile/scrum documentation, independent corroboration of sprint use.
